title: Discrete Filter
text: Model Infinite Impulse Response (IIR) filters, 5 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {External reset} sets External state reset; {Filter structure}, {Numerator Source} sets the source of numerator, {Numerator Value} sets the numerator coefficients, {Denominator Source} sets the source of denominator, {Denominator Value} sets the denominator coefficients, {Initial states Source} sets the source of initial, {Initial states Value} sets the initial filter states, {Initial states on numerator side} sets the initial numerator states, {Initial states on denominator side} sets the initial denominator states, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements, {Optimize by skipping divide by leading denominator coefficient (a0)} sets the skip divide by a0, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {View Filter Response}, {State}, {Numerator coefficients} sets the numerator coefficient data type, {Numerator coefficient minimum} sets the minimum value of numerator coefficients, {Numerator coefficient maximum} sets the maximum value of numerator coefficients, {Numerator product output}, {Numerator accumulator}, {Denominator coefficients} sets the denominator coefficient data type, {Denominator coefficient minimum} sets the minimum value of denominator coefficients, {Denominator coefficient maximum} sets the maximum value of denominator coefficients, {Denominator product output}, {Denominator accumulator}, {Output}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum value of output, {Output maximum} sets the maximum value of output, {Multiplicand data type}, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {State name} sets the assign unique name to each state and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} requires state name resolve to a signal. Values come from the instance.
